source: Tokyo Ohka Kogyo press release: Notice Regarding the Commencement of Operations at the Aso (06-08-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: TOK commenced operations at the new Aso Kumamoto Site of its Aso Plant (Kikuchi City, Kumamoto, Japan; construction completed in 2024), built for the supply and quality control of high-purity chemicals to respond to growing demand as semiconductor production expands in the Kyushu area; the company will seek to expand its supply capacity through synergy between the site and the Aso Plant. Company: the TOK Group plans total capital investments of 76.0 billion yen over the three-year tok Medium-Term Plan 2027 (began fiscal 2025), the largest investment scale in its history, and will continue to expand production capacity in Japan and overseas.
quarterly_data.figure: site investment approximately 13 billion yen; site area 128 thousand m2; 76.0 billion yen three-year capex plan
